theorem product_congruences_compatible {q r n₁ n₂ : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q)

complete_candidate_types_and_primitive_d.name: exists_product_crt_residue
complete_candidate_types_and_primitive_d.complete_source_header:
theorem exists_product_crt_residue {q r n₁ n₂ : ℕ}
    (h₁ : n₁.Coprime q) (h₂ : n₂.Coprime r)
    (hc : Nat.ModEq (q.gcd r) n₁ n₂) (a : ℤ) :
    ∃ b : ℤ, Int.ModEq q (b * n₁) a ∧ Int.ModEq r (b * n₂) a ∧
      ∀ m : ℤ, (Int.ModEq q (m * n₁) a ∧ Int.ModEq r (m * n₂) a) ↔
        Int.ModEq (q.lcm r) m b

complete_candidate_types_and_primitive_d.name: WCompatible
complete_candidate_types_and_primitive_d.complete_source_header: def WCompatible (q r n₁ n₂ : ℕ) : Prop
complete_candidate_types_and_primitive_d.complete_definition_source_block:
def WCompatible (q r n₁ n₂ : ℕ) : Prop :=
  n₁.Coprime q ∧ n₂.Coprime r ∧ Nat.ModEq (q.gcd r) n₁ n₂

instance wCompatibleDecidable (q r n₁ n₂ : ℕ) : Decidable (WCompatible q r n₁ n₂) :=
  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (n₁.Coprime q ∧ n₂.Coprime r ∧ Nat.ModEq (q.gcd r) n₁ n₂))

/-- A representative chosen from the proved CRT construction, not a supplied
progression-representation premise. Its value on incompatible inputs is unused. -/

complete_candidate_types_and_primitive_d.name: productCRTResidue
complete_candidate_types_and_primitive_d.complete_source_header: def productCRTResidue (q r n₁ n₂ : ℕ) (a : ℤ) : ℤ
complete_candidate_types_and_primitive_d.complete_definition_source_block:
def productCRTResidue (q r n₁ n₂ : ℕ) (a : ℤ) : ℤ :=
  if h : WCompatible q r n₁ n₂ then
    Classical.choose (exists_product_crt_residue h.1 h.2.1 h.2.2 a)
  else 0

complete_candidate_types_and_primitive_d.name: productCRTResidue_spec
complete_candidate_types_and_primitive_d.complete_source_header:
theorem productCRTResidue_spec {q r n₁ n₂ : ℕ} (a : ℤ)
    (hc : WCompatible q r n₁ n₂) :
    Int.ModEq q (productCRTResidue q r n₁ n₂ a * n₁) a ∧
      Int.ModEq r (productCRTResidue q r n₁ n₂ a * n₂) a ∧
      ∀ m : ℤ, (Int.ModEq q (m * n₁) a ∧ Int.ModEq r (m * n₂) a) ↔
        Int.ModEq (q.lcm r) m (productCRTResidue q r n₁ n₂ a)

complete_candidate_types_and_primitive_d.complete_source_header:
def productProgressionWeight (S : Finset ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℝ) (a : ℤ)
    (q r n₁ n₂ : ℕ) : ℝ
complete_candidate_types_and_primitive_d.complete_definition_source_block:
def productProgressionWeight (S : Finset ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℝ) (a : ℤ)
    (q r n₁ n₂ : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ m ∈ S, if Int.ModEq q ((m : ℤ) * n₁) a ∧
    Int.ModEq r ((m : ℤ) * n₂) a then w m else 0

complete_candidate_types_and_primitive_d.name: productProgressionWeight_eq_crt_progression
complete_candidate_types_and_primitive_d.complete_source_header:
theorem productProgressionWeight_eq_crt_progression
    (S : Finset ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℝ) (a : ℤ) {q r n₁ n₂ : ℕ}
    (hc : WCompatible q r n₁ n₂) :
    productProgressionWeight S w a q r n₁ n₂ =
      ∑ m ∈ S, if Int.ModEq (q.lcm r) (m : ℤ) (productCRTResidue q r n₁ n₂ a)
        then w m else 0

complete_candidate_types_and_primitive_d.name: dispersionW_eq_product_progression_sum
complete_candidate_types_and_primitive_d.complete_source_header:
theorem dispersionW_eq_product_progression_sum
    (S N Q : Finset ℕ) (w β c : ℕ → ℝ) (a : ℤ) :
    dispersionW S N Q w β c a =
      ∑ q ∈ reducedModuli Q a, ∑ r ∈ reducedModuli Q a,
        ∑ n₁ ∈ N, ∑ n₂ ∈ N,
          if n₁.Coprime q ∧ n₂.Coprime r then
            (c q * c r * β n₁ * β n₂) * productProgressionWeight S w a q r n₁ n₂
          else 0

def wSecondModulusKernel (M : ℝ) (H : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ)
    (β c₁ : ℕ → ℝ) (a : ℤ) (t : WOriginalTuple) : ℝ
complete_candidate_types_and_primitive_d.complete_definition_source_block:
def wSecondModulusKernel (M : ℝ) (H : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ)
    (β c₁ : ℕ → ℝ) (a : ℤ) (t : WOriginalTuple) : ℝ :=
  (c₁ t.1.1 * β t.2.1 * β t.2.2) *
    (∑ h ∈ Icc (-(H t.1.1 t.1.2 : ℤ)) (H t.1.1 t.1.2),
      wPoissonFrequency M a t.1.1 t.1.2 t.2.1 t.2.2 h).re

/-- The actual factored retained-frequency sum. The outer factor supports
are closed and positive, low omega is imposed only on `s`, and `q₂` has
been eliminated. The first coefficient is the arbitrary signed `c₁`. -/

complete_candidate_types_and_primitive_d.name: wMaskedFactoredTruncated
complete_candidate_types_and_primitive_d.complete_definition_source_block:
def wMaskedFactoredTruncated (M : ℝ) (H : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ)
    (N Q : Finset ℕ) (β c₁ γ ζ : ℕ → ℝ) (a : ℤ)
    (P : WOriginalTuple → Prop) (R S ξ : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ r ∈ Ioc 0 ⌊R⌋₊,
    ∑ s ∈ (Ioc 0 ⌊S⌋₊).filter (fun s => (s.primeFactors.card : ℝ) ≤ ξ),
      ∑ u ∈ wDelayedTuples N Q a P r s,
        γ r * ζ s * wSecondModulusKernel M H β c₁ a ((u.1, r * s), u.2)

/-- A general signed first coefficient is untouched by delayed expansion. -/

theorem wMaskedTruncated_factorConvolution

def wMaskedFactorExtractedTruncated (M : ℝ) (H : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ)

def wRPrimeResidual (a : ℤ) (P : WOriginalTuple → Prop)
    (Δ Δ' s' q₁ n₁ n₂ r' : ℕ) : Prop
complete_candidate_types_and_primitive_d.complete_definition_source_block:
def wRPrimeResidual (a : ℤ) (P : WOriginalTuple → Prop)
    (Δ Δ' s' q₁ n₁ n₂ r' : ℕ) : Prop :=
  let q₂ := (Δ * r') * (Δ' * s')
  a.natAbs.Coprime r' ∧ n₂.Coprime r' ∧
    Nat.ModEq (q₁.gcd q₂) n₁ n₂ ∧
    P ((q₁, q₂), (n₁, n₂)) ∧
    wSecondExtractionDivisor ((q₁, q₂), (n₁, n₂)) = Δ * Δ'

/-- Exact inner-variable conditions in the actual extracted W.
The only range of `r'` is `0 < r' <= floor(R)/Delta`; all remaining
variable-dependent restrictions are displayed in `wRPrimeResidual`.
No assertion of interval cancellation is made for this filtered set. -/

complete_candidate_types_and_primitive_d.complete_source_header:
theorem mem_wFactorExtractionTuples_fullLevel_rPrime_iff
    {R S : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hS : 0 ≤ S) (N : Finset ℕ)
    (a : ℤ) (P : WOriginalTuple → Prop) (ξ : ℝ)
    {Δ Δ' r' s' : ℕ} (hΔ : 0 < Δ) (hΔ' : 0 < Δ')
    (hr' : 0 < r') (hs' : 0 < s') (q₁ n₁ n₂ : ℕ) :
    (((Δ, Δ'), (r', s')), (q₁, (n₁, n₂))) ∈
        wFactorExtractionTuples N (Ioc 0 ⌊R * S⌋₊) a P R S ξ ↔
      r' ∈ Ioc 0 (⌊R⌋₊ / Δ) ∧ s' ∈ Ioc 0 (⌊S⌋₊ / Δ') ∧
      q₁ ∈ Ioc 0 ⌊R * S⌋₊ ∧ a.natAbs.Coprime q₁ ∧
      n₁ ∈ N ∧ n₂ ∈ N ∧
      a.natAbs.Coprime Δ ∧ a.natAbs.Coprime Δ' ∧ a.natAbs.Coprime s' ∧
      n₁.Coprime q₁ ∧ n₂.Coprime Δ ∧ n₂.Coprime Δ' ∧ n₂.Coprime s' ∧
      ((Δ' * s').primeFactors.card : ℝ) ≤ ξ ∧ s'.Coprime Δ ∧
      wRPrimeResidual a P Δ Δ' s' q₁ n₁ n₂ r'

complete_candidate_types_and_primitive_d.complete_source_header:
theorem productCRTResidue_phase_threeFactor
    {q r d d₁ D k₁ k₂ n₁ n₂ : ℕ}
    (hd : 0 < d) (hd₁ : 0 < d₁) (hDpos : 0 < D)
    (hk₁ : 0 < k₁) (hk₂ : 0 < k₂) (hn₁ : 0 < n₁)
    (hL : q.lcm r = D * k₁ * k₂) (hk₁q : k₁ ∣ q) (hk₂r : k₂ ∣ r)
    (hD : (k₁ * k₂).Coprime D)
    (hD' : (n₁ * k₁ * k₂).Coprime (d * d₁ * D))
    (hk : k₁.Coprime (n₁ * k₂)) (hn₂ : n₂.Coprime (n₁ * k₂))
    (hc : WCompatible q r (d * d₁ * n₁) (d * n₂)) (a : ℤ) :
    let D' := d * d₁ * D
    let b := productCRTResidue q r (d * d₁ * n₁) (d * n₂) a
    (((b : ℝ) / (q.lcm r) : ℝ) : UnitAddCircle) =
      (((b : ℝ) * wPhaseInverse (k₁ * k₂) D / D -
        (a : ℝ) * wPhaseInverse (n₁ * k₁ * k₂) D' / D' : ℝ) : UnitAddCircle) +
      (((a : ℝ) / ((n₁ : ℝ) * k₁ * k₂ * D') : ℝ) : UnitAddCircle) +
      (((a : ℝ) * ((d₁ : ℝ) * n₁ - n₂) *
        wPhaseInverse (D' * n₂ * k₁) (n₁ * k₂) / ((n₁ : ℝ) * k₂) : ℝ) :
          UnitAddCircle)

theorem productCRTResidue_fourier_threeFactor

    (hd : 0 < d) (hd₁ : 0 < d₁) (hDpos : 0 < D)
    (hk₁ : 0 < k₁) (hk₂ : 0 < k₂) (hn₁ : 0 < n₁)

      fourier h (((a : ℝ) * ((d₁ : ℝ) * n₁ - n₂) *

def Compatible (q r m1 m2 : ℕ) : Prop :=

def residue (q r m1 m2 : ℕ) (a : ℤ) : ℤ :=
  if h : Compatible q r m1 m2 then
    Classical.choose (exists_product_crt_residue h.1 h.2.1 h.2.2 a)
  else 0

actual_owned_public_source_API_types_and.name: residue_spec
actual_owned_public_source_API_types_and.complete_source_header:
theorem residue_spec {q r m1 m2 : ℕ} (a : ℤ) (hc : Compatible q r m1 m2) :
    Int.ModEq q (residue q r m1 m2 a * m1) a ∧
      Int.ModEq r (residue q r m1 m2 a * m2) a ∧
        ∀ n : ℤ, (Int.ModEq q (n * m1) a ∧ Int.ModEq r (n * m2) a) ↔
          Int.ModEq (q.lcm r) n (residue q r m1 m2 a)

def productProgressionWeight (S : Finset ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℝ) (a : ℤ)
    (q r m1 m2 : ℕ) : ℝ
actual_owned_public_source_API_types_and.complete_definition_source_block:
def productProgressionWeight (S : Finset ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℝ) (a : ℤ)
    (q r m1 m2 : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ n ∈ S, if Int.ModEq q ((n : ℤ) * m1) a ∧
    Int.ModEq r ((n : ℤ) * m2) a then w n else 0

actual_owned_public_source_API_types_and.complete_source_header:
def constructedProgressionWeight (S : Finset ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℝ) (a : ℤ)
    (q r m1 m2 : ℕ) : ℝ
actual_owned_public_source_API_types_and.complete_definition_source_block:
def constructedProgressionWeight (S : Finset ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℝ) (a : ℤ)
    (q r m1 m2 : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  if Compatible q r m1 m2 then
    ∑ n ∈ S, if Int.ModEq (q.lcm r) (n : ℤ) (residue q r m1 m2 a)
      then w n else 0
  else 0

/-- Noncoprime moduli use their lcm. An incompatible pair has no source
points because the original moving residue is primitive for both moduli. -/

theorem scaledDyadicCutoff_finset_progression_eq_main_add_fourier
    {M : ℝ} (hM : 0 < M) (S : Finset ℕ)
    (hS : ∀ m : ℕ, scaledDyadicCutoff M m ≠ 0 → m ∈ S)
